Theorem
[Strong maximum principle]

↗ thm:mean-value-formulas-laplace

1. ch2:2.2-thm-4\group Maximum Principles

Let $U$ be bounded and open, and let $u\in C^2(U)\cap C(\overline U)$ be harmonic.

(i) $\max _{\overline U}u=\max _{\partial U}u$.

(ii) If $U$ is connected and $u$ attains its maximum at an interior point, then $u$ is constant on $U$.
Proof

\sketch At an interior maximizer $x_0$, the mean-value formula forces $u\equiv u(x_0)$ on every ball centered at $x_0$ and compactly contained in $U$. The set of maximizers is therefore open and closed in $U$, proving (ii); (i) follows unless $u$ is constant. Apply the result to $-u$ for minima.

□
